CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: My Reservations section displays purchasable reservations for the signed-in customer
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Sign in with a customer having at least one purchasable reservation and open My Account > My Reservations.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Purchasable reservations are visible in My Reservations.
No unrelated reservation status appears in this section.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Reservation card is shown only when purchasable reservations exist
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Compare two users: one with purchasable reservations and one without; open My Reservations for both.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Reservation card appears for the user with purchasable reservations.
Reservation card is absent or clearly empty for users without purchasable reservations.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Reservation details render correctly using ProductVariantCode-based references
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect reservation list and detail actions after FE ProductVariantCode update; verify item targeting stays correct.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Displayed item identity remains correct after identifier switch.
No missing or mismatched reservation items are shown.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Reservation creation flow omits created_by and current_owner_id from FE payload
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Execute reservation creation in FE and inspect network payload for creation request fields.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Payload excludes created_by.
Payload excludes current_owner_id.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: FE handles Orca 400 validation response when ProductVariantCode cannot be resolved
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Trigger creation with an invalid ProductVariantCode in acceptance-safe setup and observe FE behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
User receives a safe and understandable error response.
Flow remains stable and does not break session context.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Core purchasable reservation visibility behaves consistently on NAP and MRP storefronts
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat visibility checks on both acceptance storefronts with equivalent reservation-ready users.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Both storefronts surface purchasable reservations in My Reservations.
No brand-specific blocker prevents the core flow.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Navigating My Reservations and attempting purchase-ready actions does not lose customer context
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate across My Account sections and back to My Reservations while interacting with reservation entries.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Customer context remains stable during navigation.
Reservation data remains scoped to the current user session.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: No-purchasable-reservation experience is clear and non-blocking
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use a user with no purchasable reservations and observe message/empty-state handling.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Empty state communicates no purchasable reservations clearly.
No broken components or confusing stale data are displayed.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Existing reservation interactions still work after identifier and payload changes
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run baseline reservation interaction flow before/after update scope in acceptance and compare outcomes.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No regression blocks core reservation interaction steps.
Updated fields behave without introducing data integrity issues.
